svg.title: Anticoagulant decision chart: the antithrombin-dependent injectables (unfractionated heparin, low molecular weight heparin, fondaparinux), the oral agents (warfarin, direct Xa inhibitors, dabigatran) and the IV direct thrombin inhibitors; each column gives when to choose it and when to avoid it, how to monitor it, and how to stop or reverse it
